title: Soliton resolution conjecture for the Benjamin-Ono equation in the sharp well-posedness space
summary: We prove the soliton resolution conjecture for the Benjamin-Ono equation in the sharp well-posedness space $H^s\left(\mathbb{R}\right)$ for $s>-\frac12$. This extends soliton resolution to the sharp regularity, whereas previous results required weighted $H^{1,1}\left(\mathbb{R}\right)$ initial data. We first prove the soliton resolution conjecture in the sharp well-posedness space for the integrable equation.
